candidate_relations.reason: The reference diagnosis specifies a Brucella melitensis soft tissue abscess directly related to the VP shunt, which is the defining clinical finding in this case. C001 identifies the etiologic agent correctly but frames it only as systemic brucellosis, missing the abscess morphology and the VP shunt association that constitute the full diagnostic object.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Names the causative organism and systemic disease but omits the anatomical localization (soft tissue abscess) and the critical contextual component (VP shunt involvement/relation)

case_quality_flags: Unusual presentation: brucellosis manifesting as a VP shunt-associated soft tissue abscess without systemic symptoms or positive serology
Negative serology noted despite culture-confirmed B. melitensis — clinically significant diagnostic caveat
